title: MixerX
tagline: Spark Your Imagination with AIGC NFT Mixer & Onboard web2 users with artistic experience in Web3
description:
MixerX stands as a cutting-edge web3 platform, employing AI technology to craft derivative works inspired by esteemed blue-chip NFTs. The platform boasts a plethora of features, including:

An exclusive "Private Model," meticulously trained by the MixerX team.
The capability to produce derivative works akin to renowned NFT projects like BAYC and Clone-X.
An innovative "Hybrid Style" function, designed for generating unique "blue-chip style" artworks.
Rapid on-chain publishing, accommodating custom feature values and batch image production.
In essence, MixerX offers a streamlined, affordable, and accessible avenue for individuals within the web3 community and crypto art enthusiasts alike to cultivate their own NFT artwork collections.
how_its_made: MixerX is an innovative web3 platform that blends advanced AI and blockchain technologies to enable the creation of derivative NFT artworks reminiscent of renowned projects like BAYC and Clone-X. The platform, built on Ethereum Layer1, leverages ERC721 standards for minting and managing NFTs, and employs a specially trained private model to generate distinctive "hybrid style" artworks. With features such as on-chain publishing, customizable feature values, and batch image production, MixerX offers a user-friendly and efficient solution for both seasoned and aspiring crypto artists to craft and manage their own NFT collections. The integration of decentralized storage through IPFS and the secure foundation provided by OpenZeppelin libraries further elevate the platform’s reliability and functionality.
